points: False claims about parties and candidates circulate on social media before the midterms
AI accelerates these campaigns, but the episode finds their impact appears limited
read: Episode show notes, 40 min (hosts Maximilian Brose, Ralf Krauter)
take: Ahead of the US midterms, AI-generated false claims spread on social media, but their measurable effect appears limited. Relevant for labelling and origin checks before EU elections.
title: Deutschlandfunk KI verstehen: AI fuels US midterm disinformation, limited effect
